## License

Poly Haven licenses all assets as CC0. Verified 2026-09-20 by fetching
https://polyhaven.com/license, which states that all assets on the site are
licensed CC0, "which is effectively Public Domain even in jurisdictions that do
not support the Public Domain."

The per-asset API response (`/info/desk_lamp_arm_01`) carries **no** `license`
field, so the CC0 status rests on the site-wide license page rather than on
per-asset metadata. Attribution is not legally required under CC0; it is
recorded here because it is the right thing to do and because the project may
want it in a credits surface.

## Integrity

Every file under `source/` was downloaded by following the URLs in
`art/after-hours/lamp-download-manifest.json` — no names were guessed. Each was
verified against the manifest's MD5 and byte size before being written, and its
SHA-256 recorded. See `CHECKSUMS.json` for the full table.

The glTF variant's shared `desk_lamp_arm_01.bin` is served from a path
containing `/8k/`. That is the single shared geometry buffer for every
resolution, not an 8K texture; no 8K texture was downloaded.

## What is original source and what is derived

- `source/` — untouched downloads. Do not edit.
- `work/desk_lamp_arm_01_work.blend` — derived editable file.
- `export/desk_lamp_arm_01.glb` — derived runtime candidate.
- `tools/` — the scripts that produced and verified the derived files.
